sanskrit_verse:
संविभागे विनिमये क्षेत्रयोरुभयोरपि ।
अनुस्मृतिकृता ताभ्यां कार्यसिद्धिर्भविष्यति ॥
transliteration: saṃvibhāge vinimaye kṣetrayor ubhayor api / anusmṛtikṛtā tābhyāṃ kāryasiddhir bhaviṣyati //
sph_interpretive_translation: In division or exchange of lands, when both parties act in accordance with remembered Dharma, success in action shall arise.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious remembrance of Dharma, not from written contract alone
Causation is established through alignment with Smriti-memory, not mere transaction
Capacity-based responsibility requires mutual recognition of ancestral and spiritual ownership
Restoration logic prioritizes harmonious land use over individual dominion
Consciousness alignment ensures that exchange does not sever connection to source
executable_legal_axioms: IF land transfer occurs AND both parties invoke Smriti-memory THEN legal validity is affirmed
IF either party lacks conscious recall of Dharma during exchange THEN transaction enters completion protocol
IF land division disrupts ancestral continuity THEN restoration process activates automatically
IF exchange results in misalignment with natural order THEN capacity rehabilitation is initiated
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that property disputes involving traditional or sacred lands must be resolved by invoking Smriti-memory. Legal standing depends not on documentary evidence alone but on the conscious recollection of Dharma by all involved parties. The court's role is to restore alignment between human intention and cosmic order, not to enforce punitive judgments.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes that true ownership arises from Smriti-memory, not paperwork. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how forgetting Dharma leads to conflict; thus resolution follows sequential awakening. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring memory, not assigning blame. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that justice emerges when consciousness reconnects with its source.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Smriti-recall ceremony for all parties to awaken ancestral knowledge
Assign completion process until land relationship aligns with Vedic understanding
Engage guru-guided mediation to restore energetic harmony of disputed area
Implement cyclical review to ensure continued alignment with cosmic rhythm
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law: Dharma is restored through conscious remembrance; reality remains non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
